TCP segments are sent as internet datagrams. The Internet Protocol (IP) header carries severalinformation fields, including the source and destination host addresses  . A TCP headerfollows the IP headers, supplying information specific to TCP. This division allows for theexistence of host-level protocols other than TCP. In the early development of the Internet suite ofprotocols, the IP header fields had been a part of TCP.
